items.html: And then those lights that were from his Tabur downward, and that rose to the place of the Chazeh, were there as Mayin Nukvin for the Nukva, they being the Taamim of SAG. And by these MAN the aforementioned coupling took place. And by this coupling they begot a new light, and this new light descended and broke through that Parsa. For above it, at the place of the Chazeh, there are now very many lights, and the place has no strength to bear them; and so the Parsa was breached, and the light descends through there from the Tabur downward and fills that whole place, which was empty of this newly born light. And this is what is written in the portion Beresheet, page 32: that it draws from above and gives to below.
